data.sql: DELETE FROM bank_orders WHERE player_id=(SELECT player_id FROM players WHERE name='bank05_rollback_payer');

tests.name: Fund payer and create one scheduled transfer

data.sql: UPDATE bank_orders SET next_run_at=to_timestamp(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)::bigint+10),last_occurrence_at=NULL WHERE bank_orders_id=@{bank05_rollback_order_id};
SELECT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM next_run_at)::bigint FROM bank_orders WHERE bank_orders_id=@{bank05_rollback_order_id};
INSERT INTO config(key,value,type) VALUES('test.deterministic_scheduler_enabled','1','int') ON CONFLICT(key) DO UPDATE SET value='1',type='int';
UPDATE cron_tasks SET enabled=(name='bank_standing_orders_tick'),next_due_at=CASE WHEN name='bank_standing_orders_tick' THEN to_timestamp(@{bank05_rollback_due}) ELSE next_due_at END;

tests.name: Create controlled failure at occurrence persistence after ledger mutations

data.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION v3_bank05_fail_occurrence() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN IF NEW.bank_orders_id=@{bank05_rollback_order_id} THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'controlled BANK-05 settlement rollback'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $$;

tests.name: Install fault injection on durable occurrence record

data.sql: CREATE TRIGGER v3_bank05_occurrence_fault BEFORE INSERT ON bank_order_occurrences FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION v3_bank05_fail_occurrence();

tests.name: Run scheduler with injected database failure
Verify failed settlement rolled back both balances, ledgers, occurrence and schedule

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN b.last_occurrence_at IS NULL AND b.next_run_at=to_timestamp(@{bank05_rollback_due}) AND (SELECT balance FROM bank_accounts WHERE owner_type='player' AND owner_id=b.player_id AND currency='CRD' AND is_active=TRUE)=100 AND COALESCE((SELECT balance FROM bank_accounts WHERE owner_type='player' AND owner_id=b.to_id AND currency='CRD' AND is_active=TRUE),0)=0 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bank_order_occurrences WHERE bank_orders_id=b.bank_orders_id) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bank_transactions WHERE tx_group_id LIKE 'bank-order-'||b.bank_orders_id||'-%') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM bank_orders b WHERE b.bank_orders_id=@{bank05_rollback_order_id};

tests.name: Requeue failed scheduled task at its still-unsettled occurrence
Retry the same occurrence without fault injection
Verify one complete payment and exactly two ledger legs after retry

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(o.*)=1 AND MAX(o.outcome)='paid' AND MAX(o.amount)=25 AND b.last_occurrence_at=to_timestamp(@{bank05_rollback_due}) AND (SELECT balance FROM bank_accounts WHERE owner_type='player' AND owner_id=b.player_id AND currency='CRD' AND is_active=TRUE)=75 AND (SELECT balance FROM bank_accounts WHERE owner_type='player' AND owner_id=b.to_id AND currency='CRD' AND is_active=TRUE)=25 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM bank_transactions WHERE tx_group_id='bank-order-'||b.bank_orders_id||'-'||@{bank05_rollback_due})=2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM bank_orders b LEFT JOIN bank_order_occurrences o ON o.bank_orders_id=b.bank_orders_id WHERE b.bank_orders_id=@{bank05_rollback_order_id} GROUP BY b.bank_orders_id,b.player_id,b.to_id,b.last_occurrence_at;
